name: Noodle Soup
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 1

Flavor Profiles texture
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, temperature, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1d4

DESCRIPTION

A noodle soup is a light, flavored broth used to cook pasta.

When a creature is targeted by an effect that requires a Fortitude saving throw, it can consume noodle soup as an immediate action in order to roll twice and take the higher result. Consuming the meal in this way does not draw attacks of opportunity.

Additional sour, spicy, or umami ingredients grant the above effect for Will saves also.

Additional bitter, salty, or temperature ingredients increase the serving size by 1 and allow the effect to occur 1 additional time within the duration.
